notes: Latest six-route user text is archived in docs/design_reports/phase1_feature_six_routes_20261013.md; this release implements its first stage, the other4 routes and Phase2 remain staged.

Norm restitution only t1 GN8x72: relative group means/std normalized by perpacketRMS; original GN and old path retained. Alpha=.2*tanh(raw),initial .05. This does not claim recovery of absolute amplitude or all preceding discarded information. Ordinary same1225-param residual uses normalized tensor only.

Competition: after1110 L steps, p=.1 uniformly masks one actual time/frequency/PA/reference evidence group on L_s student forward only. U_s, EMA teacher, V/test have full paths; deployed architecture keeps all paths. Frequency zeros actual f_proj/stat/rho routes, not every physical frequency effect.

Classifier initialization/6x160 scale30 and original ResidualPhysicalHead remain; W-only frozen probes are evidence of transferable160-dimensional embedding, not a new classifier method or source of backbone gain.

All selected final50 checkpoints use same physical source contract. Baseline source ancestor and fixed native predictions are verified, independently exposed target history retained; not a new blind benchmark.

Firstseed five-condition falsification uses source health and noninferiority, not proof of effectiveness. No candidate ranking; all registered firstseed predictions scored even when expansion fails, healthy active jobs drain.

Source feature caches, weights, raw predictions and logs remain outside Git. Git includes implementation, config, source/target aggregatedresults including negatives, perseed paired deltas and omissions.

Optional Phase2 ground summary permissions have been aligned with canonical project protocol. This Phase1 cache/probe file never becomes Phase2 runtime input; future small matching VALIDATED_ONCE support/query matrix requires own preregistration.

SourceV also measures four deterministic actual path removals with full-feature probe W held fixed; these are diagnostic only, are not used for expansion, and do not claim single isolated path efficacy.
